resources.string: Mountain Climbers for Full Body Burn
A day begins with simple stretching exercises. Take 10 minutes to warm up your body and get ready for 30 days of breakthrough!
20 minutes of squats to burn excess fat and help firm up your legs and glutes. Stay consistent with your workout to see clear results!
Challenge yourself with 15 minutes of push-ups. This exercise not only strengthens your upper body but also supports your core and arms.
The plank exercise helps you achieve firm abs. Hold the plank for 1 minute, rest for 30 seconds, and repeat 5 times to feel the difference.
Jumping jacks help elevate your heart rate and burn calories effectively. Perform 3 sets, with 20 repetitions in each set, to improve cardiovascular health.
Lunges help strengthen your legs and improve balance. Perform 3 sets of 12 repetitions on each leg for the best results.
Mountain climbers are a full-body calorie-burning exercise that raises your heart rate and enhances muscle strength. Perform 3 sets of 30 seconds each to challenge your endurance.
